description: This file defines a PHP trait called RoboTrait within the SuiteCRM project. It provides reusable methods for Robo commands, specifically methods to prompt user input and fetch configuration values.

methods.name: askDefaultOptionWhenEmpty
methods.description: Prompts the user for input with a default value if the provided option is empty.

methods.name: chooseConfigOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, returning a default if the configuration or key is empty.
